author: lactify
body:
Age: 18
Timezone: GMT
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? I have been staff on Avicus before as well as Mineplex. I properly know how to moderate from both servers experience combined, and I make sure that I follow the correct policies as well as making sure I present myself in a mature and appropriate fashion. This ranges from knowing how to moderate in game, on the forums and if applicable, TeamSpeak and even Slack. Alongside this, I have helped deal with player reports as well as making sure players are happy when playing, and if they have any problems, to just ask or message me and I will be glad to assist them.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? My biggest weakness is when I set goals but don't meet them. This will affect my moderating as any goals that I set and don't achieve means I won't progress far, which is something I wouldn't want. My biggest strength is communicating well with others alongside working well in a team. Teamwork is an important essential quality that is needed to become a moderator as at times, you will need to co-operate with other, whether it is dealing with hackers or coming to a conclusion on a certain idea.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
There are a number of ways that I can help positively contribute to the staff team. By making sure that every player is safe and enjoying themselves, that makes moderating fun and enjoyable for me. I see myself as somebody who is always looking for improvements in whatever I come across, and I love suggesting new ideas for the server that we could possibly implement and have added. At times, there are hackers and no staff are on. If I was able to become staff, I would assure that I am on Avicus at least everyday, if not, most days for 2 hours and above.


Next, I would love to help alongside any projects/community events that Avicus may run, such as scrimmages. This would also be the perfect opportunity for me to engage more with other players and other staff and it would be a great place for me to show myself for who I am and what I am capable of. I will be actively browsing the forums to see if I can get into any future coming projects and events, whether its server events or community based events. Alongside this, this may be the perfect opportunity for me to run my own events for the community.


There are many other qualities that match me such as being responsible (admitting to mistakes I may have made or owning up about a situation), having determination and motivation. I have an excellent understanding of all rules, whether it is on TeamSpeak, the server or the forums. I know what punishments apply for each severity. Alongside this, I have an excellent understanding of what and where everything is. Although this point mainly refers to the forums, it is still applicable to TeamSpeak and the server as well.
Finally, as a moderator, this will be my chance to show myself to the community who I am and what my capabilities are. I see this as an opportunity to take in as much as possible, and since I accept all types of feedback, I will take this on-board to improve on my actions so that I an produce the best possible outcome as a Avicus Moderator!



What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
There are many qualities that a leader should have to truly show themselves for who they are. Examples include: Motivation/Determination: The more you want to excel in something, in this case, being a moderator, the more effort you will put into the job, thus giving you better end results
Confident: A leader has to be confident in their abilities and decisions so that they know what to do and how to act upon things. If I have an idea, I would show confidence by making sure I tell everyone what it is and see what everyone thinks of it. Confidence will help build relationships and respect amongst people.
Organised: Moderators need to be organized, and this includes IRL too. If you have homework due tomorrow and you have not done it, but you want to moderate on Avicus, that is not being organized. Organised is having a set rota or structure that you have adhere to and follow without having any trouble or blockages stopping you. The better organized you are, the more efficient you will be in your work.
What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
Passion: Why do something you don't love? As a leader, you have to love what you are doing, or else there is no point doing it. You have t make sure you enjoy it too, and therefore you will perform to the best of your abilities, and excel with results.
There are many more qualities such as creative thinking, communicative interaction and having an open mind. I consider myself a strong born leader who is not afraid of what is ahead and yet to come. Instead, I look for the best opportunities available and will not fail to grab them at a late notice. I have led a few IRL projects in connection to my school, one of them being a painting project for a local nursery. We had to come up with characters we could paint on the walls and what equipment we would need. As leader, I made sure everyone participating knew what roles they had, when we would be painting, etc.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
Organisation: I am a well organised person who puts important things first. As a moderator, while I am expected to be a very active individual, there will be times where maybe I cannot moderate or I have to go away for sometime. I will make sure that I notify my mentor or one of my batch members that I will be gone for X amount of time. You cannot just leave without telling someone, or else this is seen as unprofessional behaviour.

Honesty: I am a very honest player who wants to earn everyone's trust. Its good to be honest as this shows you aren't afraid,depending on the situation. I would state/tell people what I am doing and why I cannot be on rather then lie about this. Lying is wrong and unethical. Your most likely going to get caught which may have dire consequences. If I was a moderator, I would promise to always be 100% honest and not lie. Simply because it gives you more trust between your pees and that you can cope with what is to come.

Communication: Throughout the years with my time on Avicus, I have come to communicate with many people whether its via TeamSpeak, the forums or the server. I see myself as a person who always likes to make new friends and stick with them. I am a very easy to talk to and approachable person. As a moderator, communication is very important as meetings between staff or ideas are discussed regularly, and it is important that would communicate your ideas or opinions well so that other people can understand you either verbally or written. As a moderator, I would make sure that any ideas I suggest or any opinions I wanted to say would be fully understood by everyone listening and to make sure they understood the point I was making. Lack of communication between staff could lead to consequences such as mishap or disorganisation, which are things we should definitely be avoiding.

Maturity: This is by far the most important quality you need to have as a moderator. If you conduct yourself in a mature way, that means you are open to anything and means you are showing yourself in a positive way. If you act immature, you are showing yourself in an uncoordinated, unprofessional manner. I deem myself as a mature individual who seeks feedback for improvements and can handle any given situation, good or bad. Mature also reflects on your personality. If you swear, shout or rant a lot, then moderator is not the rank for you. If you are generally kind, approachable and have a good personality. then you have a shot at getting moderator. My personality shows me as a happy person who loves to make friends always wanting to improve in every area they can. Maturity is one key aspect of being a moderator!


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
At least 2 hours per day, maybe more on weekends. I will try to be on everyday, if not, most days!

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? The first thing I would do is see if I can get a another mod on, via Slack. If not, I will just get evidence of all accounts the ban evader has used to be banned by a moderator or higher later when one joins. I will explain to them what happened regarding the ban evader, and that I have significant proof of them.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? Ask the staff member to leave, since that was the leader's request. If they do not comply, go to a higher member of staff (senior mod) to help out.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? Unpunish them due to the evidence being corrupted. You will also have to take note to get a better recording software so that this won't happen again. Unpunish them if they have made a significant appeal.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? Tell the staff member to watch what he posts in the discord, as he could face a demotion by "accidentally leaking staff information". I would tell them to delete it even though its not confidential, and warn them once again to not post staff-seeable information in the discord chat again, or serious consequences may follow.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? Give your opinion of this decision in a constructive feedback style way, and see what is said after. Do not argue blatantly and go against the decision, as this shows unprofessionalism and immaturity.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
Getting moderator on Avicus would mean a ton for me. Not just because I want to ban "all the hackers" but because I want to rejoin the staff team again. I had an absolute blast when I was accepted back in 2015, and I would like to experience that opportunity again. I know I have a lot of infractions as a whole, but over the past 8 months, have only gotten 3, truthfully. I know infractions are looked upon seriously when considering staff positions, but  I would like to say that I heavily apologise if I have acted in ways which would not deem be fit to be staff. However, I have moved past that, and I hope I can prove to you that I would be fit to be staff once again!

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
Very passionate, this is my favourite server, and I have really close within its community, whether its scrimming, hanging out with players and staff, breaking monuments In Nebula, I just love Avicus so much, its become a huge part of my life. Without Avicus, I probably wouldn't even be playing Minecraft, so thank you for existing Avicus!

Do you speak any other languages than English?
A tiny bit of Spanish


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I am a 18 year old student attending Sixth Form. I study Business Studies, Maths and Applied Science.
I attend a basketball training club every Saturday from 12am to 1pm GMT
I am a current volunteer at a charity, I will be seeking a job soon.
Avicus was the 8th server I joined on when I began to play Minecraft Multiplayer
I have had Minecraft since 2011.
I have Slack, if I am accepted, you may PM me for my email address.
I am learning how to play the piano as a extra curricular activity outside of Sixth Form
I am a huge fan of horror stories.


Finally, like I do on all my apps, I hereby acknowledge the requirements and know that I meet them to high expectations, as well as know that asking staff to review my app will result in a denial! Thanks in advance for reading!
